title: Pullman's back corner gets its raised terrace and striped awning
items: At the Pullman house's back corner on 18th Street, the plain brick box is gone. In its place is the raised stone terrace that Taylor's photographs show: a balustrade around it, an arched basement window below, and a green-and-white striped awning sloping down from the wall.
Its size and heights come from Taylor's summer photograph. His winter view shows the same balustrade with the awning taken down. The scene is set in July, so the awning is up.
